recipe.visualDefinition: A monochromatic sepia-toned group portrait of four men in formal attire, featuring heavy top-weighted typography in a vibrant mustard yellow, set against a dark, textured studio background.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast mustard yellow text against dark sepia photography
Staggered depth of subjects creating a triangular group composition
Tight vertical stacking of display and subtitle text at the top margin
Distressed paper texture overlaying the entire composition
coreInvariants: Monochromatic sepia color palette for the image
Low-angle or eye-level studio lighting with deep shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men positioned centrally, waist-up, filling the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold yellow display text at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright top text, moves down through the faces of the subjects, and settles on the tracklist at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, vignetted corners and a textured background provide breathing room around the subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep sepia and dark brown tones in the photographic base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Mustard yellow for primary and secondary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/cream for highlights in clothing and small metadata text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright yellow text and the dark, low-saturation background.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones and one high-saturation yellow

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold geometric sans-serif with rounded terminals
letterConstructionRules: Extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Rounded outer corners and flat horizontal baselines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'E' features a shortened middle bar
The letter 'A' has a very small, low-positioned counter
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of ultra-bold display type with functional condensed sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Heavy grain and paper scuff textures

candidateDirections.reason: Suitable for the bottom tracklist metadata

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A sepia-toned studio portrait of four men in 1960s formal suits and cravats, arranged in a tight group. Apply a heavy film grain and distressed paper texture with visible scuffs and edge wear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add ultra-bold rounded display text in mustard yellow at the top. Add a two-line tracklist in condensed yellow sans-serif at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic sepia?
Is the display text ultra-bold and rounded?
Is the texture distressed and vintage-looking?
Is the text color a consistent mustard yellow?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of yellow for text
Number of subjects in the portrait
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Original brand names or specific song titles

avoid: Thin, delicate fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'haloing' around text; it should look printed on, not glowing.
Ensure the grain is uniform across both subjects and background.
Verify the yellow color doesn't lean too far into neon or lemon.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a dark sepia-toned group portrait with ultra-bold, rounded mustard yellow typography at the top and condensed metadata at the bottom, finished with a heavy vintage paper texture.
